text:
Maya: Heads up — thinking of doing a weird combo this weekend: thrift-store crawl in the morning, then making pierogi in the afternoon. Anyone joining?
Tom: Love pierogi. Count me in for the cooking. What fillings?
Maya: Potato+cheese to start, maybe spinach feta and apple cinnamon for dessert 😂
Sanjay: Thrift crawl also sounds 🔥 — which neighborhood? I can bring a card table for folding.
Priya: I have a pierogi press!! will bring. Also I might be late, heading to a soccer game in the AM ⚽
Maya: Thinking Fremont + the vintage market at 10am, then my place in the afternoon around 3pm. RSVP so I can buy flour.
Tom: RSVP: in for pierogi, maybe skip the thrifting (kid's birthday) — can I bring sour cream and onions?
Sanjay: In for thrift + pierogi. Bringing a selection of weird aprons.
Lena: Ooh I can bring gluten-free dough option. @Maya do you need parking? I can carpool with @Sanjay
Maya: Parking's tight but there's a spot near the cafe. DM me if you want to carpool.
Priya: @Maya can you share recipe or just wing it? I'm new to pierogi.
Maya: I'll drop a quick recipe snippet here later; it's easy, promise. Also if anyone wants just the thrift + coffee option feel free.
Tom: Also movie night after? low-key vote: '90s rom-com or indie sci-fi?
Sanjay: Indie sci-fi pls
Maya: Poll results: pierogi ✅, thrift ✅, indie sci-fi wins. See y'all Saturday! :v:
